standard_prerequisites.name: The standing Langevin setting of Section 3.1 and the Section 2 block notation: D the position space with potential V, beta the inverse temperature, nu the Gibbs measure e^{-beta V} dq / Z on D, kappa the momentum measure e^{-beta U} dp / Z_kappa, mu the product measure, the Hamiltonian and fluctuation/dissipation generators cLham (journal (3.2)) and cLFD (journal (3.3)), the projector Pi_0 (journal (3.4)), the block decomposition cLa_subplus0 = Pi_subplus cLa Pi_0 with the inverse (cLa_subplus0^* cLa_subplus0)^{-1} of Assumption 2.2, the projectors Pi_1, Pi_2 and the generator split cL = cLs + cLa with cLs = gamma cLFD, cLa = cLham
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: the Section 3.1 opening prose (source lines 545-579) and the Section 2 block notation, outside the counted spans
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes D, beta, V, U, nu, kappa, mu and every block operator, projector and constant appearing in the counted statement and proof.

core_obligations: Verify Assumption 2.2 (ass:A_inv): the Poincare inequality in the momentum variable yields s = gamma K_kappa^2/beta (proof lines 622-625).

Rewrite the generators with the adjoint identities partial^* = -partial + beta potential-gradient and the commutation rules, and establish the numbered identity eq:A^*A_Langevin for cLa_subplus0^* cLa_subplus0 (proof lines 626-642).

Prove cLM symmetric positive definite from xi^T cLM xi = beta int |xi^T nabla U|^2 d kappa (contradiction with e^{-beta U} in L^1), and derive macroscopic coercivity a = K_nu sqrt(lambda_min(cLM)/beta) from the Poincare inequality for nu (proof lines 643-655).

Verify the first half of Assumption 2.6: decompose -Pi_1 cLFD Pi_1 = (1/beta) sum T_ij TildeT_ij, bound T_ij by the integration-by-parts estimate ||Pi_0 partial_{p_k}|| <= beta ||partial_{p_k} U||_{L^2(mu)}, bound TildeT_ij through (nabla_q^* cLM nabla_q)^{-1/2} partial_{q_j}^* and adjoints, concluding cLs_11 bounded (proof lines 657-680).

Verify the second half of Assumption 2.6 through eq:op_for_Ass5: bound the second term via eq:action_cLa2 and eq:Sij_Tij plus the boundedness of the second-derivative and drift-composed blocks (in view of the regularization condition eq:regularization condition, with DMS15 Proposition 5 and ST18 Lemma A.4 as inputs), and bound the first term via the explicit operator scrT_i whose boundedness uses the Assumption 3.2 moment bounds (proof lines 682-710).
Conclude the counted multline bound eq:bounds_invL_Langevin by applying Theorem thm:bounds_Linv (proof line 710).
proof_roadmap: Verify Assumption 2.2 with s = gamma K_kappa^2/beta (proof lines 622-625).
Establish eq:A^*A_Langevin by adjoint rewriting (proof lines 626-642).
Positive-definiteness of cLM and coercivity constant a (proof lines 643-655).
Boundedness of cLs_11 via the T_ij / TildeT_ij decomposition (proof lines 657-680).
Boundedness of the eq:op_for_Ass5 operator, term by term (proof lines 682-710).
